usageNotes: Use this to list all ACME challenge plugins configured at the cluster level — call it before creating or assigning a plugin to a domain in an ACME account. Requires the Sys.Modify privilege at the root path (/). Filter by type='dns' or type='standalone' to narrow results; omit the parameter to return all plugins regardless of type.
tips: The 'standalone' plugin type is built-in and requires no additional API credentials; DNS plugins each reference a specific provider API (e.g., 'cf' for Cloudflare, 'hetzner' for Hetzner DNS).
The 'disable' flag on a returned plugin means it will not be used for certificate issuance even if assigned — check this field when troubleshooting ACME certificate failures.
The 'validation-delay' field (default 30 s) is critical for DNS plugins with high TTLs; if cert issuance fails with DNS propagation errors, increase this value on the plugin.
The 'nodes' field restricts which cluster nodes may use the plugin; an empty/absent value means all nodes are allowed.
